title: Cobblemon Cobalt Edition
description: This modpack contains additions to the base Cobblemon 1.7.3 such as TMs, breeding, mega evolution, and more.
body:
This modpack seeks to bring additional functionality to the Cobblemon Official Modpack (for version 1.7.3). It adds:
- AllTheMons: Adds over 130 missing pokemon
- Mega Showdown: Adds Mega Evolution, Z Moves, Dynamax, and Terastalization
- SimpleTMs: Adds TMs and TRs
- Ability Upgrade - Cobblemon: Adds crafting recipes for ability capsules and ability patches
- CobblemonCapture XP: Gain XP from capturing pokemon
- Cobblemon Raid Dens: Adds raid dens that spawn around the map
- Cobbreeding: Adds breeding functionality to the pasture block
